claims.claim: A Nepal Land Revenue Office publication lists 1 ropani=5476 ft² and 1 bigha=72900 ft², with 16 aana per ropani and 20 katha per bigha.
claims.implementation_note: These published relationships are the base constants for traditional-unit conversion.

claims.claim: Metric conversion uses the international foot = 0.3048 m exactly.
claims.implementation_note: Square-metre output derives from the exact length definition.

uncertainty: See sources.json and page limitations; product specifications, codes and local practices can override illustrative defaults.
